source_snapshot.items: Check GPU Libraries is suitable for rocBLAS
source_snapshot.procedure: Build ROCm and rocBLAS, then create a system-wide OpenCL symlink, set library paths, compile `example_srot.c` with `-lclBLAS -lOpenCL`, and run it.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes a generic rocBLAS smoke/info test and omits the literal clBLAS/OpenCL program and unsafe symlink.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies rocBLAS versus clBLAS/OpenCL API conflict and requires matching sources, input/reference/tolerance, loader provenance and isolated execution.

old_problem: Title/build require rocBLAS, but the executable step links clBLAS/OpenCL; building rocBLAS cannot make `-lclBLAS` exercise it, and a system-wide library symlink can alter unrelated software.
disposition_reason: rocBLAS and clBLAS are distinct libraries/APIs and cannot be reconciled by parameter substitution. No ED rule selects the title/build over the literal compile/run procedure or authorizes splitting coverage. Core library identity, example and numerical oracle must be approved before a truthful test case exists.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row213 all18 XLSX cells and history2817.
Preserved rocBLAS title/build and clBLAS/OpenCL SROT procedure as conflicting source evidence.
Prohibited the global `/usr/lib/libOpenCL.so` symlink and generic smoke substitution. No build, link or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GPU BLAS suitability pending rocBLAS versus clBLAS/OpenCL scope decision
test_case.purpose: After project authority selects or splits the library scope, build and execute the matching BLAS example against the intended artifact and verify numerically correct GPU results with provable runtime linkage.
required_package: Authoritative decision: rocBLAS, literal clBLAS/OpenCL SROT, or separately identified variants
Pinned matching ROCm/library sources/packages, revisions and checksums
Approved example source, input vectors, expected SROT output and numerical tolerance
Compiler/linker command, isolated runtime library path and loaded-library hash manifest
Stable GPU target map, cleanup and error/thermal recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not compile while library identity is unresolved. For the approved branch, build the pinned matching library and example, use an isolated loader path without system-wide symlinks, record compiler/link trace and runtime loaded-library hashes, execute the approved numerical case on the stable GPU target, and compare complete output with its reference/tolerance. A rocBLAS smoke cannot pass clBLAS coverage or vice versa.
test_case.expected_result: The selected example compiles and loads only the approved library artifacts, executes on the intended GPU, produces the complete numerically correct result within tolerance, and leaves no loader, GPU or platform fault or persistent system modification.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative library identity, matching API/example, proven runtime linkage and approved numerical comparison. Process exit or generic info output cannot pass the conflicting source.
safety_gate: Do not create or replace `/usr/lib/libOpenCL.so` or change global loader configuration.
Use isolated build/runtime directories and stable GPU identity.
Verify loaded shared-object paths/hashes before trusting output.
Abort on unintended library resolution, compiler/linker error, numerical mismatch or GPU fault; clean only isolated artifacts and do not retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Pinned source/package checksums and build manifest
Compiler/link commands and runtime loaded-library paths/hashes
Complete numerical output, GPU/kernel logs and isolated cleanup
test_case.recovery: Remove only isolated build/runtime artifacts and environment changes; do not modify global symlinks. On library or GPU fault, preserve trace/output/logs and restore the original environment before owner review.

source_conflict.reason: rocBLAS title/build and clBLAS/OpenCL SROT compile/run remain materially different library coverage.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until library identity and numerical oracle are approved.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Choose/split rocBLAS versus clBLAS, then provide matching artifacts, example, numerical oracle and isolated loader contract.
pending.owner: ROCm library, AMD GPU software and testcase identity owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve a single authoritative API/library path or independently identified variants with matching numerical tests.

project_authority: The intended BLAS API and project-specific numerical oracle cannot be inferred from mismatched source text.
